name: Rumors for Kravel
summary: Krazek has found what you came for. After calling in favors, doing plenty of deducing and giving up a rare bottle of elven wine, Krazek wrote a letter about Nazz Steamboil. It is too dangerous for Krazek to use, so you carry it to Kravel Koalbeard, out on the Shimmering Flats, and you are asked not to say where it came from.

sections.title: A Letter From Krazek
sections.body: Krazek tells you what the search cost: some favors were used up, a rare bottle of elven wine was parted with, and a good deal of deducing was done. The result is a letter holding some very interesting bits about Nazz Steamboil. Krazek finds it too dangerous to use, and leaves it to you to do with as you will, as long as nobody learns where it came from. It goes back to Kravel Koalbeard, out on the Shimmering Flats.

sections.title: Kravel's Verdict
sections.body: Kravel finds the letter very interesting. He muses that perhaps he should bow to the goblin pilot next time they meet, and expects Nazz to part with a small fortune so the secret stays buried.

aliases: where do i get the rumors
faq.answer: Krazek gives you the letter in Booty Bay, after you bring the dream dust.

faq.q: To whom should the letter be brought?
aliases: where to turn in rumors for kravel
faq.answer: To Kravel Koalbeard, at the Mirage Raceway out on the Shimmering Flats of Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Who is the subject of Krazek's findings?
faq.answer: Nazz Steamboil, the goblin racer pilot. Krazek wrote down some very interesting bits about Nazz in the letter.

faq.q: How did Krazek uncover the information?
aliases: how did krazek get the info
faq.answer: Krazek used up some favors, did some heavy deducing, and parted with a rare bottle of elven wine.

aliases: next quest after rumors for kravel
faq.answer: The next step in the chain is Back to Booty Bay.
